lines: The Hollow Court opens into a drowned amphitheatre of broken stone.
At its centre, a dormant Crest node pulses — faint, but awake.
Figures move between the pillars. They were here first.

battle_intro.speaker: Warden Elara Thorne
lines: Raiders. And that one carries a Riven mark — do not let it corner you.
Formation. We hold, we do not chase.

battle_intro.speaker: Mira Solen
lines: They are between us and the node. Of course they are.
The last raider drops. The Court is still again — almost.
The dormant node flares once, bright and deliberate, turned toward you.
Something beneath the Hollow Court has made its choice.
The party is driven back into the dark of the stairway...
The Hollow Court keeps its secrets. For now.
